about: This release's own additions to the carried hostgen.json (release_carry.py merges them): each with why.

func_V1_L00_002B55F0_1.why: rac2-decomp's func_PAL_L00_002B5518 (src/pal/levels/shared/L00_002B5518-cc.c) is its PAL copy of func_L00_002B55F0, which the release table could not pair (the C calls it by its _1 spelling, which the release's build gave no value); call_copies.tsv pairs this caller's call with it in every level (func_L00_002B59B0 -> func_L00_002B5518 at level 0). Without it the hero's position history copies a stale ring entry over his position every tick and he falls to 0,0,0

func_V1_802EE138_1.why: the file's own note: func_802EE138_1 becomes func_00282CF0 (v1.01), PAL's func_002835B0, as in L00_003B9CB8.c's aliases

func_V1_802EE3D0_1.why: the file's own note: func_802EE3D0_1 becomes func_00282F20 (v1.01), PAL's func_002837E0, as in L00_003B9CB8.c's aliases

func_L00_002BDB68.why: the file calls func_US2_L00_002B2DD0, USA v2.00's name; PAL's copy of that function (the same catalogue row, 1052 bytes) is func_PAL_L00_002B2BE0

func_V1_L00_0037E5F0.why: v1.01's func_L00_0037E5F0, which PAL has as its own func_PAL_L00_00381328 (versionmap: same code, level 0; 76 bytes)

func_V1_L00_003F0198_2.why: v1.01's func_L00_003F0198 (its _2 spelling), PAL's own func_PAL_L00_003F4518 (versionmap: near, level 0; 1252 bytes both)
